notes.title: The Betweenlands Demo EagleCon Update
notes.notes:
As promised, here is the update to The Betweenlands Demo. I showed this version off at EagleCon this weekend, and I'm so glad so many people seemed to love it! We got a small speedrunning community going by the end, although I still hold the record by a large margin hehe. 
https://i.imgur.com/tLEmztq.jpeg
With this demo update, I will return to mostly working on the full game, so the demo might not be updated again (at least no major updates). I know there are still a few bugs in this version (like the fog, grappling crumbling stone), but I want to move on and tell the full story of Mori and her world. There's so much I've learned from working on this demo that I want to start applying to the full game.

For a bit of a teaser, here's some info on what I plan the final game to look like. First of all, it will be much much bigger, with each major area being at least as big as this entire demo. The areas will also be much less linear, allowing for more exploration and environmental storytelling. Speaking of which, there will be a much larger focus on the story with more characters and dialogue and lore.

Anyway, here are the precise patch notes:

Audio:

New music by Benjamin Borthwick!
Pulley sound effects
Crumbling stone sound effects
Some ambient sound effects
Grappling sound bug fixed

https://i.imgur.com/CaTocpR.png
Graphics:

Background art improved
Lots of particle effects
Dynamic fog
Post processing
Glowing crystals
Bigger checkpoint flags
Various sprites improved
2 Dialogue portraits added, others tweaked
Grapple and pulley rope texture

https://i.imgur.com/Ghbu1Ux.png
Gameplay:

Completely reworked Morewell area
Added special camera zones to some Greenwall areas
Made the "Greenwall Hell" area more forgiving
Minor level tweaks all over the place
Option to detach grapple with jump input
Option to automatically enable new checkpoints
Remappable controls
Reset (respawn) button

https://i.imgur.com/QmUP4jj.png
UI:

Death counter (enabled in options)
Speedrun timer (enabled in options)
Announcement banner when entering a new area
Controller menu navigation fixed
Buttons and menus cleaned up

https://i.imgur.com/PC0svCY.png
